description: This file implements the CustomerDAO interface for accessing customer data in a database, providing methods to retrieve customers by ID, name, nickname, and store, with various filtering and fetch strategies.

classes.name: CustomerDAOImpl
classes.description: Implementation of CustomerDAO that provides database access methods for Customer entities, utilizing QueryDSL support for JPA.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a Customer entity by its ID with related fetch joins.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customers matching the provided name, considering first and last name.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists customers associated with a specific store, applying optional filters from CustomerCriteria.

methods.name: getByNick
methods.description: Retrieves a customer by its nickname, with optional store filtering.

methods.name: listByStore (overload)
methods.description: Lists all customers for a store without filters.
